scope: 67 files included in Stage39 release; excludes historical source files
method: Mask JavaScript comments, quotes and template literals, find top-level function declarations and unqualified cross-file identifiers immediately followed by '('; resolve only unique definitions

tool_provenance.analyzer: Custom scoped lexical scan via GitHub source reads

limitations: Not a runtime trace and not AST-quality static analysis; counts indicate potential direct call sites, not execution frequencies
Excludes calls from HTML strings/template interpolation, callbacks referenced without parentheses, property/method calls, dynamic lookup and closure/IIFE definitions
Top-level scope detection can be imperfect around regular expressions and template syntax
Identical global function names declared in multiple files are excluded as ambiguous
Number of calls is a count of static code tokens; verify important links manually before refactoring
